description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the SelfUserDetails API resource in the Apache Fineract project. It contains data models describing the response structure for retrieving self-user details, including nested classes for roles and organizational roles.

classes.name: SelfUserDetailsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Final class containing nested static classes that define the data models for Swagger documentation of the self-user details API response.

classes.name: SelfUserDetailsApiResourceSwagger.GetSelfUserDetailsResponse
classes.description: Data model representing the main response structure for the getSelfUserDetails API, including user info, roles, permissions, and organizational roles.

classes.name: SelfUserDetailsApiResourceSwagger.GetSelfUserDetailsResponse.GetSelfUserDetailsOrganisationalRole
classes.description: Data model for the organizational role information associated with the user.

classes.name: SelfUserDetailsApiResourceSwagger.GetSelfUserDetailsResponse.GetSelfUserDetailsRoles
classes.description: Data model for individual role details assigned to the user.
